title: Trustworthy AI Must Account for Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2504.07170v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Trustworthy AI encompasses many aspirational aspects for aligning AI systems with human values, including fairness, privacy, robustness, explainability, and uncertainty quantification. The ultimate goal of Trustworthy AI research is to achieve all aspects simultaneously. However, efforts to enhance one aspect often introduce unintended trade-offs that negatively impact others. In this position paper, we review notable approaches to five aspects and systematically consider every pair, detailing the negative interactions that can arise. For example, applying differential privacy to model training can amplify biases, undermining fairness. Drawing on these findings, we take the position that current research practices of improving one or two aspects in isolation are insufficient. Instead, research on Trustworthy AI must account for interactions between aspects and adopt a holistic view across all relevant axes at once. We offer recommend

translated_title: 可信人工智能必须考虑各维度间的相互作用
translated_abstract: 可信人工智能涵盖了将AI系统与人类价值观对齐的许多理想目标，包括公平性、隐私性、鲁棒性、可解释性和不确定性量化。可信人工智能研究的最终目标是同时实现所有这些方面。然而，提升某一方面的努力往往会引入意想不到的权衡，从而对其他方面产生负面影响。在这篇立场论文中，我们回顾了五个方面的代表性方法，并系统地考察了每一对维度组合，详细阐述了可能出现的负面相互作用。例如，在模型训练中应用差分隐私可能会放大偏见，从而损害公平性。基于这些发现，我们的立场是：目前孤立地改进一两个方面研究实践是不够的。相反，可信人工智能研究必须考虑各方面之间的相互作用，并同时采取覆盖所有相关维度的整体视角。我们提出了相应的建议。
tldr: 可信人工智能的各维度（如公平性、隐私、鲁棒性等）之间存在负面相互作用，例如差分隐私可能放大偏见损害公平性，因此研究必须放弃孤立改进单一方面做法，转而采用同时兼顾所有维度的整体视角。
en_tdlr: Trustworthy AI research must account for negative interactions between aspects (e.g., differential privacy can amplify bias and undermine fairness) and adopt a holistic view across all dimensions simultaneously, rather than improving aspects in isolation.
